description.summary: With a flourish, you can immediately end a maintained 1st level or higher song to inflict a number of creatures equal to the song level of the song you ended with the Stunned status effect.
description.value: With a flourish, you can immediately end a maintained 1st level or higher song to inflict a number of creatures equal to the song level of the song you ended with the Stunned status effect . Stunned: A stunned creature drops everything held, can’t take actions, takes a –2 penalty to AC, and loses its Dexterity bonus to AC (if any). Attackers receive a +4 bonus on attack rolls to perform combat maneuvers against a stunned opponent.
